measures.title: Madera County Transient Occupancy Tax (TOT Increase)
measures.summary: Asks whether Madera County's existing transient occupancy tax, paid only by hotel and short-term rental guests, should be raised by two percent, to 11% of the rent charged, until ended by voters. The county estimates about $1,780,000 a year, with independent audits; the ballot question lists 911 emergency response, law enforcement, road repair, water quality, jobs and businesses, and other general county services as uses.
measures.yesMeans: The county's hotel and short-term rental tax rises by two percent, to 11%.
measures.noMeans: The tax stays at its current rate.
